name: Sad
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of sadness and brokenness, assuring believers that God is near to the brokenhearted and saves those with a contrite spirit. While sorrow and weeping may endure temporarily, joy and healing follow as God sustains His people and binds up their wounds. Believers are encouraged to cast their burdens upon the Lord, trusting in His faithfulness to uphold them and restore their hope.
